interaction: pointer-driven 3D luminous ring, no scroll animation
layout: fixed centered TENSA.; German invitation above foreground hoodie; compact signup right on desktop, below on mobile

states.center: ring centered behind opaque near-black hoodie silhouette
states.left: ring moves and rotates left, subtle left illumination
states.right: ring moves and rotates right, subtle right illumination

ring.material: White emission, KHR_materials_emissive_strength=12; WebGL white core plus occlusion-aware Gaussian bloom
ring.modifications: PCA alignment, center and scale normalization, texture replacement with emission
ring.surface_cleanup: Precision circular tube remesh using the generated normalized dimensions, 512 segments x 32 sides. Uniform white emission, 2x supersampled offscreen rendering and Gaussian bloom. No image texture or normal shading. Original Tripo source kept separately.

rendering: 3D ring with perspective and depth; photo-based garment stays near black with directional outer-edge lighting and a faint neutral logo silhouette. Mouse/touch motion unchanged.
discount: 15 percent for all registrations before launch; no count cap
accessibility: keyboard arrows and Home on scene
logo_lighting: Local horizontal gradient: stronger left half for left light, stronger right half for right light, remaining half faint; center nearly invisible. Garment contour lighting unchanged.
drop_status: Full-screen entrance: decorative counter eases to 72% while the scene loads, then the same bar travels onto the marked lower torso position above the pouch pocket (64% down the garment canvas). It stays at 72%. Scene readiness gates the reveal with a timeout fallback; this number is not network progress. Reduced motion skips travel. After arrival, a narrow pulsing light sweeps left to right across the track every 3.4 seconds; the 72% fill and number remain fixed. Disabled for reduced motion.
visible_controls: Move to discover on desktop, Swipe to discover on touch; no visible range slider or direction labels
wordmark: Clean original TENSA. typography with permanent frontal fill and a directional silver highlight following the eased ring position. CSS lighting approximation, not the rejected generated wordmark.
coming_soon: Below single-line invitation, three dots bounce sequentially in a continuous gentle rhythm; reduced-motion disables bounce.

intro_emblem.source: Image-generation extraction of the user-supplied flat elephant logo, with empty central banner
intro_emblem.presentation: Fades to 20% white behind a original, unstretched HTML TENSA. wordline. The blank banner border is masked away so only the elephant remains behind the text; fades away as the loading bar travels to the lower torso.
